Fictional Study B: Multilingual Educational Chatbot


SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ? NOT A REAL RESEARCH PAPER

Research objective: Examine language support in education assistants. Methodology: A hypothetical
interface was evaluated with simulated English-language prompts. Dataset: 80 fabricated prompts.
Finding: The fictional model gave inconsistent responses to code-switched prompts. Limitation: No
real-world user study was performed.

Fictional Study B: Multilingual Educational Chatbot

SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ? NOT A REAL RESEARCH PAPER

Research objective: Study automated qualitative feedback on student writing. Methodology:
Compare two fictional prompt designs using simulated assignments. Dataset: 60 fabricated writing
samples. Finding: The toy examples varied in feedback specificity. Limitation: No robustness tests or
external validation were included.
